notes.title: Dev Update: Character & System Overhaul
notes.notes:
🎮 Dev Log Update | Major Improvements to Characters & Core Systems
Hi everyone,
I’m the solo developer behind this game, and I’d love to share some progress I’ve made recently.
This update focuses on refining character depth, upgrading gameplay systems, and improving overall immersion. Let’s dive in:

✨ Character Development & Worldbuilding Enhancements
I’ve spent time polishing each character’s backstory and personality, making them feel more vivid and emotionally grounded.
You’ll also notice more nuanced interactions and expressions, aimed at strengthening your emotional connection with them.

🏃 Movement System Overhaul
A new running mechanic has been added, allowing for more dynamic and responsive movement, especially in tense sequences.
Animations have been smoothed out to make movement feel more fluid and natural.

🧩 Puzzle Design Upgrades
I’ve introduced new puzzles that are more closely tied to the story.
They’re designed to feel logical and meaningful while offering a stronger sense of challenge and progression.

🛠 Bug Fixes & Performance Optimization
Several known issues have been addressed, and overall game performance has been improved.
You should notice smoother gameplay and a more stable experience.

🎬 CG Cutscenes & Visual Enhancements
New high-quality CG cutscenes have been added to highlight key story moments.
I’ve also enhanced lighting and color grading across various scenes to create a stronger emotional atmosphere.
